Here’s a table of the **top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq-100 (NDX)** as of the latest available data (June 2024), including their **market capitalization** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratio**. Note that these figures fluctuate daily based on market conditions.

| **Rank** | **Company**               | **Ticker** | **Market Cap (USD Billion)** | **P/E Ratio (TTM)** | **Weight in NDX (%)** |
|----------|---------------------------|------------|-----------------------------|---------------------|-----------------------|
| 1        | Microsoft                 | MSFT       | ~3,200                      | ~37                 | ~9.5%                 |
| 2        | Apple                     | AAPL       | ~3,100                      | ~30                 | ~8.5%                 |
| 3        | NVIDIA                    | NVDA       | ~2,800                      | ~75                 | ~7.5%                 |
| 4        | Amazon                    | AMZN       | ~1,900                      | ~55                 | ~5.5%                 |
| 5        | Meta (Facebook)           | META       | ~1,200                      | ~28                 | ~4.5%                 |
| 6        | Alphabet (Google) - Class A | GOOGL    | ~2,100                      | ~27                 | ~4.0%                 |
| 7        | Alphabet (Google) - Class C | GOOG     | ~2,100                      | ~27                 | ~3.8%                 |
| 8        | Tesla                     | TSLA       | ~550                        | ~45                 | ~3.0%                 |
| 9        | Broadcom                  | AVGO       | ~450                        | ~50                 | ~2.5%                 |
| 10       | Costco                    | COST       | ~320                        | ~55                 | ~2.2%                 |

### **Key Notes:**
1. **Market Cap & P/E**: Data is approximate (as of June 2024) and sourced from **Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, and Nasdaq**.
2. **P/E Ratio**: Trailing Twelve Months (TTM) is used. Some companies (e.g., Amazon, Tesla) have higher P/Es due to growth expectations.
3. **Weighting**: The Nasdaq-100 is **market-cap weighted**, so larger companies have a bigger impact on the index.
4. **Recent Changes**: NVIDIA has surged in weight due to AI-driven growth, while Tesla’s weight has declined slightly.

### **Where to Verify?**
- **Nasdaq Official Site**: [Nasdaq-100 Holdings](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)
- **Financial Data**: [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets)
